bloc.La carte réglementaire dit où l'IA est e: The regulatory map says where AI is regulated. This one says where it is produced: notable models, elite researchers (NeurIPS), patents granted and adoption by European companies. Each series carries its source, its licence and its precision.

texte.Cette page traite du Règlement (UE) #/#,: This page covers Regulation (EU) #/#, already adopted; what is still going through the procedure is tracked there.
texte.Cybersécurité des entités essentielles e: Cybersecurity of essential and important entities. Applies to AI systems in critical infrastructure. Incident reporting obligations.
texte.Divergence normative accrue avec l'appro: Greater regulatory divergence from the European approach. Constraints eased for US developers, but uncertainty over safety reporting. The States (Colorado, California) continue with their own regulation.
texte.Encadre la responsabilité des plateforme: Governs the liability of online platforms and intermediaries: combating illegal content, transparency of recommender and moderation systems. Interlocks with the AI Act for algorithmic moderation systems.
texte.Encadre les 'contrôleurs d'accès' (grand: Governs “gatekeepers” (large digital platforms) to ensure fair conditions of competition. Relevant for AI systems built into platforms designated as gatekeepers.
texte.Entree en application des pratiques IA i: Prohibited AI practices start to apply (Art. # AI Act)
texte.Exigences de cybersécurité pour tout pro: Cybersecurity requirements for any product with digital elements (software and hardware). Vulnerability reporting obligations from # September #, full application on # December #.
texte.Export du modèle de surveillance IA via: Export of the AI surveillance model via the BRI to #+ developing countries
texte.Exportation du modèle vers le Brésil (PL: Export of the model to Brazil (PL #), Chile, Canada (AIDA)
texte.Fin des directives federales de safety t: End of the federal safety-testing directives imposed on large models. A shift towards deregulation and competitiveness.
texte.Fragmentation interne : patchwork réglem: Internal fragmentation: a patchwork of state regulation creating uncertainty for companies
texte.Friction UE-US : divergence croissante s: EU-US friction: growing divergence on the safety of foundation models and on data transfers
texte.Interprétation officielle des # pratique: Official interpretation of the # prohibited AI practices (Art. #). Cumulative conditions, practical use cases, sectoral examples.

texte.Jusqu'à #% du CA mondial (#% en récidive: Up to #% of worldwide turnover (#% for a repeat offence)
texte.L'EU AI Act (Règlement #/#) s'impose com: The EU AI Act (Regulation #/#) stands as the world’s first binding horizontal framework. Through its extraterritorial mechanism, it applies to any company targeting the European market, exerting a global regulatory effect comparable to the “Brussels Effect”.
texte.La Chine a développé un corpus réglement: China has developed a dense, targeted body of AI regulation, built around content control, data sovereignty and algorithmic security. An alternative model to the European fundamental rights approach, exported via the BRI’s digital routes.
texte.La Commission europeenne publie ses Guid: The European Commission publishes its Guidelines on Prohibited AI Practices detailing the cumulative conditions of the # prohibitions of Article #, with practical use cases. A non-binding document, authoritative interpretation being reserved to the CJEU.
texte.La publication du modele open-weights De: The release of the open-weights DeepSeek R# model, trained at costs presented as far lower than those of American laboratories, calls into question the effectiveness of chip export controls and America’s technological lead.
texte.Les # categories de pratiques a risque i: The # categories of unacceptable-risk practices become directly applicable throughout the EU: subliminal manipulation, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring, predictive policing based on profiling, untargeted scraping of facial images, emotion recognition at work/in education, biometric categorisation of sensitive data, and real-time remote biometric identification. The AI literacy obligation (Art. #) also applies.
texte.Les entreprises operant en Europe doiven: Companies operating in Europe must audit their systems immediately. Fines of up to EUR # million or # % of worldwide turnover. The first milestone of a cascading application through to #.
texte.Les fournisseurs de modeles de fondation: Providers of foundation models (GPAI) must comply with the transparency and documentation obligations. The fines of Article # become enforceable.
texte.Les obligations pour les modeles d'IA a: The obligations for general-purpose AI models (GPAI) become applicable, as does the penalty regime of Article #. Member States were to designate their market surveillance authorities (MSAs) by this date.
texte.Les regles de la Cyberspace Administrati: The Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) rules on labelling AI-generated content strengthen the obligation of visible and implicit (metadata) marking of synthetic content, in continuity with the Generative AI Measures of #.
texte.Liens directs vers les textes officiels: Direct links to official texts and public databases
texte.Localisation des données : obstacle maje: Data localisation: a major obstacle to multinational deployments
texte.Nouveau standard de watermarking en Chin: New watermarking standard in China. Platforms must adapt their content distribution chain. A model potentially exported to partner countries.
texte.Nouvel Executive Order # - virage pro-in: New Executive Order # - American pro-innovation shift
texte.Obligations GPAI et regime de sanctions: AI Act GPAI obligations and penalty regime applicable
texte.Observatoire R&D dans le domaine de l'IA: R&D observatory in the field of AI
texte.Point critique : DeepSeek R# (jan. #) a: Critical point: DeepSeek R# (Jan. #) showed that a high-performing model could be developed under computing-chip constraints, partly circumventing American export controls and shifting the global strategic balance.
texte.Point critique : les entreprises US opér: Critical point: US companies operating in the EU remain subject to the AI Act. Regulatory decoupling forces multinationals to maintain two separate compliance frameworks.
texte.Premier cadre horizontal mondial sur l'I: The world’s first horizontal framework on AI. Risk classification, high-risk obligations, prohibited practices, GPAI, penalties. Phased application #-#.
texte.Recommandations pour gérer les risques s: Recommendations for managing AI-specific risks, complementing ISO #. Covers risks related to data, to the dynamics of AI performance and to societal impacts. Complementary to ISO/IEC #.
texte.Referentiel d'interpretation essentiel p: An essential interpretation reference for DPOs and compliance officers, to assess whether a system falls under a prohibited practice.
texte.Remise en question de la strategie ameri: The American containment strategy called into question. Debates over the security of Chinese models deployed internationally and over the relevance of export restrictions.
texte.Renforcement de l'etiquetage des contenu: Stronger labelling of AI content in China
texte.Rupture majeure en janvier # : l'adminis: Major break in January #: the Trump administration revokes EO # (Biden) and signs EO #, reorienting federal AI policy towards competitive “dominance” and deregulation. Fragmentation between the federated States is increasing.
